## 0.1 Refactor Notes

This V9 applies the consolidated marketplace cleanup manifests to the Snapdeal V8 canonical markdown and the Snapdeal Recon DOCX. It removes process-variant misuse, repairs lifecycle/workflow cards, corrects source-backed relationships, creates a SQL pattern registry, encodes observed benchmark context as metric guidance, and keeps scope identifiers as column-level specs only.

```yaml
  id: evidence.snapdeal.088.tds_framework_income_tax_act_section_194_o
  source_section: TDS Framework (Income Tax Act, Section 194-O)
  heading_level: 3
  summary: 'TDS Framework (Income Tax Act, Section 194-O) Section 194-O (inserted by Finance Act 2020) mandates e-commerce operators to deduct TDS at 1% on the gross
    amount of sales facilitated through their platform for Indian sellers. This applies when: The seller has a PAN The gross sales exceed ₹5 lakh per financial year
    Rate: 1% of gross order value (0.5% if PAN not available — 2% prior to amendments) In the data: TDS amounts are typically ₹0.13–₹0.25 per order On an order of
    ₹176 (avg chargedamount), 1% TDS ≈ ₹1.76 — the small amounts suggest these may be per-item or partial TDS entries Snapdeal deducts and deposits TDS on behalf
    of sellers; sellers get credit via Form 26AS'
  source_line_start: 968
  source_line_end: 983
```

### 3.7 value_profile cards

```yaml
candidate_card:
  display_name: Snapdeal return settlement classification values
  table_id: table.zs_observe.snapdeal_settlement
  column_id: column.zs_observe.snapdeal_settlement.type
  profile_kind: documented_return_settlement_classification
  values:
  - type: RTO
    trigger: Delivery failed, returned to origin hub
    settlement_type: COD/NCOD RTO Charges
    courier_cost: charged to seller
  - type: RTS
    trigger: Buyer-initiated return after delivery / return-to-seller
    settlement_type: COD/NCOD RTS to Vendor
    courier_cost: reverse logistics charged
  - type: RTV
    trigger: Buyer-initiated return to vendor
    settlement_type: COD Return to Vendor / NCOD Ret to Vendor
    courier_cost: forward and reverse both reversed
  - type: RPR
    trigger: Return + repackage at Snapdeal hub
    settlement_type: COD RPR Charges
    courier_cost: premium repackage charge
  do_not_create_process_variant: true
  marketplace_only: true
  evidence_refs:
  - evidence.snapdeal.lifecycle_v9
  - evidence.snapdeal.manifest_cleanup_v9
  confidence: high
  review_status: ready
  card_type: value_profile
  card_id: value_profile.snapdeal.return_settlement_classification
```

```yaml
candidate_card:
  display_name: Snapdeal formula pattern — Payment vs Settlement Reconciliation
  formula_text: |-
    SELECT
      p.transaction_date AS payment_date,
      p.utr_no_,
      p.gross_amount AS payment_amount,
      SUM(s.settled_amount) AS sum_settled,
      p.gross_amount - SUM(s.settled_amount) AS variance
    FROM zs_observe.snapdeal_payments p

    LEFT JOIN zs_observe.snapdeal_settlement s
      ON p.utr_no_ = s.settlement_id
      AND s.is_active = true
    WHERE p.is_active = true
    GROUP BY p.transaction_date, p.utr_no_, p.gross_amount
    ORDER BY p.transaction_date;
  sql_pattern_id: sql.snapdeal.8_2_payment_vs_settlement_reconciliation
```

```yaml
  sql_pattern: "SELECT\n  c.sub_order_no,\n  c.total_commission_amount AS commission,\n  c.tax_amount AS gst_on_commission,\n  o.charged_amount AS order_value,\n\
    \  ROUND(100.0 * ABS(c.total_commission_amount) / NULLIF(o.charged_amount, 0), 2) AS take_rate_pct\nFROM zs_observe.snapdeal_commission c\nLEFT JOIN zs_observe.snapdeal_oms\
    \ o\n  ON c.sub_order_no = o.suborder_code\n  AND o.is_active = true\nWHERE c.is_active = true\n  AND c.transaction_type LIKE '%Vendor Invoice%';"
  filters: Use exactly the filters in formula_sql / linked sql_pattern, especially is_active=true, transaction_type/type scope, and group_level_id column scope where
    runtime supplies it.
  grain: as specified in metric SQL or source section
  sign_convention: Preserve source sign convention; normalize only when rule explicitly says so.
  aggregation_order: Pre-aggregate many-side fee/settlement/reverse tables before joining where the source query or reconciliation section implies many-to-one.
  metric_pattern: snapdeal_specific_implementation_of_commission_or_take_rate
  evidence_refs:

  - evidence.snapdeal.metrics_benchmarks_v9

      c.sub_order_no,
      c.total_commission_amount AS commission,
      c.tax_amount AS gst_on_commission,
      o.charged_amount AS order_value,
      ROUND(100.0 * ABS(c.total_commission_amount) / NULLIF(o.charged_amount, 0), 2) AS take_rate_pct
    FROM zs_observe.snapdeal_commission c
```

```yaml
candidate_card:
  metric_id: metric.unmatched_returns_return_without_settlement
  platform_context_id: platform_context.snapdeal.in
  display_name: Snapdeal implementation — Unmatched Returns (Return without Settlement)
  source_tables:
  - zs_observe.snapdeal_sales_return
  - zs_observe.snapdeal_settlement
  formula_text: Executable SQL-like implementation normalized in V9; see formula_sql and sql_pattern_id.
  sql_pattern: "SELECT\n  r.order_id,\n  r.invoice_number,\n  r.charged_amount\nFROM zs_observe.snapdeal_sales_return r\nLEFT JOIN zs_observe.snapdeal_settlement\
    \ s\n  ON r.invoice_number = s.invoice_number\n  AND s.is_active = true\nWHERE r.is_active = true\n  AND s.invoice_number IS NULL;"
  filters: Use exactly the filters in formula_sql / linked sql_pattern, especially is_active=true, transaction_type/type scope, and group_level_id column scope where
    runtime supplies it.
  grain: as specified in metric SQL or source section
  sign_convention: Preserve source sign convention; normalize only when rule explicitly says so.
  aggregation_order: Pre-aggregate many-side fee/settlement/reverse tables before joining where the source query or reconciliation section implies many-to-one.
  metric_pattern: snapdeal_specific_implementation_of_unmatched_returns_return_without_settlement
  evidence_refs:
  - evidence.snapdeal.5_5_unmatched_returns_return_without_settlement
  - evidence.snapdeal.metrics_benchmarks_v9
  - evidence.snapdeal.manifest_cleanup_v9
  - evidence.snapdeal.sales_return_empty_v9
  confidence: high
  review_status: ready_with_population_caveat
  card_type: metric_implementation
  card_id: metric_impl.snapdeal.unmatched_returns_return_without_settlement
  formula_sql: |-
    SELECT
      r.order_id,
      r.invoice_number,
      r.charged_amount
    FROM zs_observe.snapdeal_sales_return r
    LEFT JOIN zs_observe.snapdeal_settlement s
      ON r.invoice_number = s.invoice_number
      AND s.is_active = true
    WHERE r.is_active = true
      AND s.invoice_number IS NULL;
  sql_pattern_id: sql.snapdeal.5_5_unmatched_returns_return_without_settlement
  source_columns:
  - order_id
  - invoice_number
  - charged_amount
  - snapdeal_sales_return
  - snapdeal_settlement
  - is_active
  - r
  - s
  source_table_ids:
  - table.zs_observe.snapdeal_sales_return
  - table.zs_observe.snapdeal_settlement
  population_caveat: snapdeal_sales_return is empty in current data; implementation is future-ready only.
```

```yaml
candidate_card:
  display_name: Snapdeal query pattern — 7.4 Join OMS → Settlement
  intent: marketplace_analysis_or_reconciliation_query
  source_tables:
  - zs_observe.snapdeal_oms
  - zs_observe.snapdeal_settlement
  required_filters: Preserve filters exactly as shown in source SQL; active/scope-like filters are columns/caveats only, not account-binding cards.
  sql_template: |-
    SELECT
      o.suborder_code,
      o.invoice_number,
      o.charged_amount AS oms_charged,
      s.settled_amount AS settled,
      s.commission,
      s.courier_fee
    FROM zs_observe.snapdeal_oms o
    LEFT JOIN zs_observe.snapdeal_settlement s
      ON o.invoice_number = s.invoice_number
      AND s.is_active = true
      AND s.transaction_type = 'forward'
    WHERE o.is_active = true
      AND o.transaction_type = 'forward';

  sql_pattern_id: sql.snapdeal.7_4_join_oms_settlement
  output_fields:
  - suborder_code
  - invoice_number
  - oms_charged
  - settled
  - commission
  - courier_fee
  required_rule_ids:
  - rule.snapdeal.active_filter
  - rule.snapdeal.scope_fields_are_columns
  - rule.snapdeal.settlement_date_filter_policy
  - rule.snapdeal.revenue_vs_cashflow_scope
  - rule.snapdeal.commission_is_marketplace_fee_total
  - rule.snapdeal.seller_code_not_cross_table_join_key
  join_filter_policy: Keep settlement filters in the LEFT JOIN ON clause; placing s.is_active in WHERE turns the query into an inner join and hides unmatched OMS
    rows.
```

```yaml
candidate_card:
  display_name: Snapdeal rule — active filter
  rule_type: parser_semantic_rule
  statement: Apply is_active = true to all production Snapdeal table queries. group_level_id='22' is documented scope context but remains a column/filter, not account
    binding.
  condition: All Snapdeal production query generation unless querying raw inactive history explicitly.
  severity: high
  evidence_refs:
```

```yaml
candidate_card:
  display_name: Snapdeal benchmark and observed context guidance only
  rule_type: metric_interpretation
  statement: Observed values and statutory/contextual rates documented in the DOCX belong in metric benchmark/context fields but must not become hard validation failures
    without platform/account/category/time-period context.
```

## 4. SQL Pattern Registry

```yaml
sql_pattern:
  id: sql.snapdeal.10_1_oms_settlement_matching
  title: 10.1 OMS ↔ Settlement Matching
  query_pattern_id: query_pattern.snapdeal.014.10_1_oms_settlement_matching
  source_doc_section: 10.1 OMS ↔ Settlement Matching
  sql_template: |-
    SELECT
      o.invoice_number,
      o.charged_amount AS oms_gmv,
      s.settled_amount AS settlement_net,
      CASE WHEN s.invoice_number IS NULL THEN 'Not in Settlement' ELSE 'Matched' END AS status
    FROM zs_observe.snapdeal_oms o
    LEFT JOIN zs_observe.snapdeal_settlement s
      ON o.invoice_number = s.invoice_number
      AND s.is_active = true
      AND s.transaction_type = 'forward'
    WHERE o.is_active = true
      AND o.current_order_state = 'Delivered';
  source_tables:
  - table.zs_observe.snapdeal_oms
  - table.zs_observe.snapdeal_settlement
  required_filters: Preserve filters exactly as shown in source SQL; active/scope-like filters are columns/caveats only, not account-binding cards.
  output_fields:
  - invoice_number
  - oms_gmv
  - settlement_net
  - status
  evidence_refs:
  - evidence.snapdeal.10_1_oms_settlement_matching
  - evidence.snapdeal.manifest_cleanup_v9
  confidence: high
```
```yaml
sql_pattern:
  id: sql.snapdeal.10_2_payments_settlement_matching
  title: 10.2 Payments ↔ Settlement Matching
  query_pattern_id: query_pattern.snapdeal.015.10_2_payments_settlement_matching
  source_doc_section: 10.2 Payments ↔ Settlement Matching
  sql_template: |-
    SELECT
      p.utr_no_,
      p.gross_amount AS payment_received,
      SUM(s.settled_amount) AS sum_of_settlement_lines,
      p.gross_amount - SUM(s.settled_amount) AS variance
    FROM zs_observe.snapdeal_payments p
    LEFT JOIN zs_observe.snapdeal_settlement s
      ON p.utr_no_ = s.settlement_id
      AND s.is_active = true
    WHERE p.is_active = true
    GROUP BY p.utr_no_, p.gross_amount;
  source_tables:
  - table.zs_observe.snapdeal_payments
  - table.zs_observe.snapdeal_settlement
  required_filters: Preserve filters exactly as shown in source SQL; active/scope-like filters are columns/caveats only, not account-binding cards.
  output_fields:
  - utr_no_
  - payment_received
  - sum_of_settlement_lines
  - variance
  evidence_refs:
  - evidence.snapdeal.10_2_payments_settlement_matching
  - evidence.snapdeal.manifest_cleanup_v9
  confidence: high
```

```yaml
sql_pattern:
  id: sql.snapdeal.10_3_commission_validation
  title: 10.3 Commission Validation
  query_pattern_id: query_pattern.snapdeal.016.10_3_commission_validation
  source_doc_section: 10.3 Commission Validation
  sql_template: |-
    SELECT
      c.invoice_number,
      c.total_commission_amount AS commission_invoice,
      s.commission AS settlement_commission,
      ABS(c.total_commission_amount - s.commission) AS variance
    FROM zs_observe.snapdeal_commission c
    LEFT JOIN zs_observe.snapdeal_settlement s
      ON c.invoice_number = s.invoice_number
      AND s.is_active = true
    WHERE c.is_active = true;
```

```yaml
sql_pattern:
  id: sql.snapdeal.10_5_tds_reconciliation_non_order_vs_settlement
  title: 10.5 TDS Reconciliation (Non-Order vs Settlement)
  query_pattern_id: query_pattern.snapdeal.018.10_5_tds_reconciliation_non_order_vs_settlement
  source_doc_section: 10.5 TDS Reconciliation (Non-Order vs Settlement)
  sql_template: |-
    SELECT
      n.sub_order_no,
      n.gross_amount AS non_order_tds,
      s.settled_amount AS settlement_tds,
      ABS(n.gross_amount) - ABS(s.settled_amount) AS variance
    FROM zs_observe.snapdeal_non_order n
    LEFT JOIN zs_observe.snapdeal_settlement s
      ON n.sub_order_no = s.item_id
      AND s.is_active = true
      AND LOWER(s.type) LIKE '%tds inv%'
    WHERE n.is_active = true
      AND n.transaction_type LIKE '%TDS INV%';
  source_tables:
  - table.zs_observe.snapdeal_non_order
  - table.zs_observe.snapdeal_settlement
  required_filters: Preserve filters exactly as shown in source SQL; active/scope-like filters are columns/caveats only, not account-binding cards.
  output_fields:
  - sub_order_no
  - non_order_tds
  - settlement_tds
  - variance

  confidence: high
```

```yaml
sql_pattern:
  id: sql.snapdeal.7_4_join_oms_settlement
  title: 7.4 Join OMS → Settlement
  query_pattern_id: query_pattern.snapdeal.056.7_4_join_oms_settlement
  source_doc_section: 7.4 Join OMS → Settlement
  sql_template: |-
    SELECT
      o.suborder_code,
      o.invoice_number,
      o.charged_amount AS oms_charged,
      s.settled_amount AS settled,
      s.commission,
      s.courier_fee
    FROM zs_observe.snapdeal_oms o
    LEFT JOIN zs_observe.snapdeal_settlement s
      ON o.invoice_number = s.invoice_number

    WHERE o.is_active = true
```

```yaml
sql_pattern:
```

```yaml
  title: 8.2 Commission Invoice Validation vs Settlement
  query_pattern_id: query_pattern.snapdeal.040.8_2_commission_invoice_validation_vs_settlement
  source_doc_section: 8.2 Commission Invoice Validation vs Settlement
  sql_template: |-
    SELECT
      c.invoice_number,
      c.sub_order_no,
      c.total_commission_amount AS commission_invoice_amt,
      s.commission AS settlement_commission,
      c.total_commission_amount - s.commission AS variance
    FROM zs_observe.snapdeal_commission c
    LEFT JOIN zs_observe.snapdeal_settlement s
      ON c.invoice_number = s.invoice_number
      AND s.is_active = true
    WHERE c.is_active = true;
```

```yaml
sql_pattern:
  id: sql.snapdeal.8_2_payment_vs_settlement_reconciliation
  title: 8.2 Payment vs Settlement Reconciliation
  query_pattern_id: query_pattern.snapdeal.033.8_2_payment_vs_settlement_reconciliation
  source_doc_section: 8.2 Payment vs Settlement Reconciliation
  sql_template: |-
    SELECT
      p.transaction_date AS payment_date,
      p.utr_no_,
      p.gross_amount AS payment_amount,
      SUM(s.settled_amount) AS sum_settled,
      p.gross_amount - SUM(s.settled_amount) AS variance
    FROM zs_observe.snapdeal_payments p
    LEFT JOIN zs_observe.snapdeal_settlement s
      ON p.utr_no_ = s.settlement_id
      AND s.is_active = true
    WHERE p.is_active = true
    GROUP BY p.transaction_date, p.utr_no_, p.gross_amount
    ORDER BY p.transaction_date;
  source_tables:
  - table.zs_observe.snapdeal_payments
  - table.zs_observe.snapdeal_settlement
  required_filters: Preserve filters exactly as shown in source SQL; active/scope-like filters are columns/caveats only, not account-binding cards.
  output_fields:

  - utr_no_
  - payment_amount
  - sum_settled
  - variance
```

```yaml
  query_pattern_id: query_pattern.snapdeal.030.8_3_join_to_oms_for_tds_rate_validation
  source_doc_section: 8.3 Join to OMS for TDS Rate Validation
  sql_template: |-
    SELECT
      n.sub_order_no,
      n.gross_amount AS tds_amount,
      o.charged_amount AS order_value,
      ROUND(100.0 * ABS(n.gross_amount) / NULLIF(o.charged_amount, 0), 4) AS effective_tds_rate_pct
    FROM zs_observe.snapdeal_non_order n
    LEFT JOIN zs_observe.snapdeal_oms o
      ON n.sub_order_no = o.suborder_code
      AND o.is_active = true
    WHERE n.is_active = true
      AND n.transaction_type IN ('COD TDS INV', 'NCOD TDS INV');
  source_tables:

  - table.zs_observe.snapdeal_oms
```

```yaml
sql_pattern:
  id: sql.snapdeal.8_4_oms_settlement_reconciliation
  title: 8.4 OMS ↔ Settlement Reconciliation
  query_pattern_id: query_pattern.snapdeal.049.8_4_oms_settlement_reconciliation
  source_doc_section: 8.4 OMS ↔ Settlement Reconciliation
  sql_template: |-
    SELECT
      o.invoice_number,
      o.charged_amount AS oms_charged,
      o.transaction_type AS oms_type,
      s.settled_amount,
      s.commission,
      s.courier_fee,
      s.type AS settlement_type,
      CASE
        WHEN s.invoice_number IS NULL THEN 'Unmatched in Settlement'
        ELSE 'Matched'
      END AS recon_status
    FROM zs_observe.snapdeal_oms o
    LEFT JOIN zs_observe.snapdeal_settlement s
      ON o.invoice_number = s.invoice_number
      AND s.is_active = true
      AND s.transaction_type = 'forward'
    WHERE o.is_active = true
      AND o.transaction_type = 'forward';
```

```yaml
sql_pattern:
  id: sql.snapdeal.8_5_effective_take_rate_per_order
  title: 8.5 Effective Take Rate per Order
  query_pattern_id: query_pattern.snapdeal.043.8_5_effective_take_rate_per_order
  source_doc_section: 8.5 Effective Take Rate per Order
  sql_template: |-
    SELECT
      c.sub_order_no,
      c.total_commission_amount AS commission,
      c.tax_amount AS gst_on_commission,
      o.charged_amount AS order_value,
      ROUND(100.0 * ABS(c.total_commission_amount) / NULLIF(o.charged_amount, 0), 2) AS take_rate_pct
    FROM zs_observe.snapdeal_commission c
    LEFT JOIN zs_observe.snapdeal_oms o
      ON c.sub_order_no = o.suborder_code
      AND o.is_active = true
    WHERE c.is_active = true
```

```yaml
      settlement_id,
```
